text:
Hello, passing on the depot's account below.

An operative at the Northvale Daventry loading bank is with the first-aider, suspected broken leg after a forklift reversed into him. The forklift has been isolated. Please pick up this account from the depot. This happened at 10.20; an ambulance has been called.

Please come back to us about this.

Caller: DVSA checked the driver's Driver CPC card on the M6 near Carlisle and found it expired.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Driver's CPC card was out of date; advice given and Northvale have to provide evidence of renewal.
Caller: Ambient load, delivery still on time. Please follow up the card renewal evidence for this check.

NV21 WQS parked overnight at the truck stop off the A5 near Hinckley. At 05:00 driver found the nearside curtain slashed and six pallets of spirits gone. He slept in the cab and heard nothing during the night. Police have been called; please pick up the missing goods.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

About a third of the ceramic tiles on the pallet for Greystone Builders Merchants in Stoke-on-Trent have cracked. No one was near it, no injuries. Please arrange for the lift to be checked as well. Rigid NV71 TLF's tail-lift suddenly dropped mid-lower and tipped the pallet.

Please come back to us about this.

Driver's report, as received: Reefer fuel shows about two hours left and refuelling isn't allowed in the inspection area. The inspection area at Dover won't allow refuelling of chilled trailer NV20 TCH's reefer. Box reading four degrees currently; the reefer tank only has around two hours of fuel remaining.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

The men are still outside artic NV17 HJT, parked in a lay-by on the A12 near Colchester at twenty to midnight. Driver has locked himself in and phoned 999. Load is Sable Electronics TVs. Two of them trying to open the trailer doors, one also banged on the cab.

Please come back to us about this.

Customer's report, as received: It's cushions and throws, one carton has a scuffed corner, though the contents are unmarked. I'm furious about the Tollbridge Retail cushions and throws home delivery, what a disaster! Still, the whole delivery feels wrecked to me, can somebody please respond to this.

NVT 2218 is at Northvale Avonmouth depot after the heavy rain. The roof sheet is torn and water has got into Tollbridge Retail's flat-pack furniture cartons and soaked them. Please pick up the wet cartons and the torn sheet on this trailer.

We're unloading at Northvale Thurrock depot and an IBC valve has split. It's UN1824 sodium hydroxide solution, ADR class 8, leaking onto the trailer floor and out into the yard. Area cordoned off and spill kit in use, but it's still leaking. Please pick this up.

Caller: At 09:30 during trans-shipping at Northvale Daventry depot, a forklift crushed two Halcyon Medical insulin cartons.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Two Halcyon Medical cartons were crushed by a forklift while being trans-shipped at Northvale Daventry at half nine; the pens inside are broken.
Caller: They were for a hospital pharmacy by 16:00 today and replacement stock can't reach it by then. Please pick up the failed delivery window as well.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

NV19 FPL's trailer is on fire at the brakes, parked in Hilton Park services HGV park on the M6. Load is ambient paper products for Marlow & Finch. Passing through the account of the fire now. Driver has moved people away and called the fire brigade.

Please come back to us about this.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

The vaccine pallet for the hospital pharmacy in Norwich was left behind at Northvale Daventry's chilled store when loading. We cannot get it there by the booked time. Driver discovered it wasn't on board on arrival for the 10:00 slot. It's Halcyon Medical vaccines, seal fine and nothing else wrong.

Please come back to us about this.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Brackenridge Foods' tins are on artic NV16 KCR, ambient load, ordinary booking with no deadline flagged. The problem now is the westbound A14 closure after a collision we weren't involved in. We've lost three hours and won't make the booked time. The earlier engine warning near Cambridge cleared at services and checks found no fault.

Please come back to us about this.

Hello, passing on the depot's account below.

Yesterday afternoon a pedestrian crossing Northvale Warrington depot yard was nearly hit by a reversing trailer. A colleague has raised it today rather than yesterday. Please follow up what happened in the yard. The shunter was reversing without a banksman; no one got hurt.

Please come back to us about this.

Driver's report, as received: The dangerous goods note is missing from the paperwork pack. Before NV19 ADR leaves Northvale Thurrock depot we need its dangerous goods note, which isn't in the pack. All drums intact, labels correct, no leaks. Vehicle hasn't departed; this is about the absent document.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

The vehicle was allowed to continue after the DVSA check near Carlisle on the M6. It is carrying ambient goods and remains on time for delivery. Can somebody pick up the card point please. Driver's CPC card was out of date; advice given and Northvale have to provide evidence of renewal.

Please come back to us about this.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

This is a huge problem, the customer is going mad over the Tollbridge RDC Lutterworth booking! No flagged deadline and RDC are rebooking, but we need this picked up please. Artic NV22 PTD with ambient groceries is caught in heavy M62 traffic between J22 and J24, now due noon instead of 10:00.

Please come back to us about this.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Driver waiting in the Calais lorry park, artic NV22 YAC heading to Dover with Pennine Paints returns from export. That's the account being passed through. He says the customs papers are all fine. He also says the French broker rejected the declaration because its EORI number is incorrect.

Please come back to us about this.

Driver's report, as received: It's UN1263 paint, class 3 flammable, in 25-litre steel drums. They're upright, no leak seen and no smell. Customer in Bradford has refused damaged Pennine Paints drums: three dented, with a lid cracked on one. All upright and nothing seen leaking or smelt. Sending the drum details through.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Three pallets haven't turned up on the NV22 HPL delivery to Brackenridge RDC Doncaster. We can't account for the shortage. The driver insists he opened an intact seal, but the RDC have checked the door seal number against the manifest and it is different.

Please come back to us about this.

Caller: Recovery truck requested for 18-tonne rigid curtainsider NV68 PLW, gearbox failed.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Gearbox has failed just beyond a bend, vehicle immovable on the single carriageway. Traffic is passing it by using the opposite lane.
Caller: Building supplies for Greystone Builders Merchants, Hereford, no deadline. Please advise on recovery.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Before NV19 ADR leaves Northvale Thurrock depot we need its dangerous goods note, which isn't in the pack. All drums intact, labels correct, no leaks. Vehicle hasn't departed; this is about the absent document. The rigid is loaded with class 8 UN1824 sodium hydroxide solution drums.

Please come back to us about this.

Driver's report, as received: That's the report we've got about it and the request is for a call back. Can someone call back about the Rotterdam job please, driver says the paperwork isn't right. Would appreciate somebody speaking to the driver about it and coming back to us.

Driver's report, as received: Their loaders stacked tile adhesive bags over boxed light fittings. The driver didn't see them loading. This is about the mixed load on artic NV17 AJD from Pennine Paints' Huddersfield warehouse. Greystone Builders Merchants' Oxford branch found the lower cartons crushed at delivery and recorded it on the POD.

Hello, passing on the subcontractor's account below.

The overnight parcels trunk to Northvale Daventry is running roughly three hours behind. It's ambient parcels with no flagged deadline on this run. Subcontractor Redgate Logistics called it in at half one: the M25 is shut between J10 and J11 for a police incident unrelated to us.

Please come back to us about this.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Can't find loaded Northvale trailer NVT 4012 on the booked bay at Brackenridge RDC Doncaster, we've LOST it! Ambient snacks, no deadline, but I'm panicking over where this whole trailer has gone. Yard team believe their shunter shifted it to the overflow yard; they're checking that now.

Please come back to us about this.

Caller: Had a bump this morning, all ok.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Would somebody call back about it please, that's the account being passed on.
Caller: Please pick this up and speak to the driver about it so somebody can follow it through from here.

Caller: NV18 SRA wouldn't start at 06:10 after the night at the truck stop off the A5 near Hinckley.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: There's no fuel, the filler cap has been forced and it smells of diesel round the tank. Driver believes somebody siphoned it during the night.
Caller: The trailer seal is intact and matches the paperwork, ambient tinned food untouched.

Driver arrived for the Norwich hospital pharmacy's 10:00 Halcyon Medical vaccine delivery, but the pallet isn't on the vehicle. Northvale Daventry confirm it was left in the chilled store during loading. Seal fine, nothing else wrong. There's no way to get the vaccines to Norwich by ten now.

01:00 at Holyhead and check-in have refused the Dublin sailing. The ENS safety and security declaration hasn't been lodged for the Tollbridge Retail ambient stock load. Driver is parked up waiting for the broker. Next sailing is four hours away; please get the declaration sorted.

Driver's report, as received: Door seal number differs from both CMR and manifest; several cartons have been opened and the tablets inside are smashed. Tollbridge RDC Lutterworth have quarantined the Sable Electronics tablet load on artic NV22 SUV. Please follow up the seal and the damaged contents together.

Driver's report, as received: It's the rigid with the consignment for Kestrel Pharma, running about an hour late. The Kestrel Pharma consignment on rigid NV69 OPA is going to be roughly an hour behind. Please pick up the timing change and come back to us, passing on the driver's update as received.

Caller: 03:05, early-run driver at Northvale Avonmouth depot can't start tractor NV23 FPE, batteries flat.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Driver arrived for the early run at five past three and found flat batteries, tractor won't start.
Caller: Can the night desk sort a jump pack or a spare tractor please, that's what the driver is asking for.

Driver's report, as received: Spare missing from cradle. Driver safe; it's 10:05 and tyre service is ninety minutes away. The county hospital renal unit's eleven o'clock delivery of dialysis fluids and consumables will be missed. Driver safe there. At five past ten, tyre service ETA is 90 minutes.

Delivery made to Fenwick Garden Supplies in Chelmsford, but there's no POD signature. Goods-in supervisor wouldn't sign until her manager checked the load, and the manager wasn't available. The driver left the goods there and came away unsigned. Can someone follow up the signature please.

Caller: Could you advise what to do with NV22 COI please, steel coils for Corvid Automotive.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Hard braking shifted the coils, which are pressing out against the bulging curtain. Driver thinks one could come through onto the road if he moves.
Caller: He's concerned a coil could come through onto the road if he moves. Just asking for guidance.

NV21 HRD, Northvale Freight DAF XF artic with curtainsider, lost drive in lane 1 on the M6 NB between J10 and J8. It's 05:40, dark, no hard shoulder on this smart motorway stretch. Hazards on, driver behind the barrier and National Highways called. 26 ambient grocery pallets for Brackenridge Foods RDC Doncaster; recovery needed.

All fine really, just a scratch at Greystone Builders Merchants' Wolverhampton yard. Trailer clipped their banksman while reversing onto a bay. Graze and bruising to his forearm, first aid given. Please pass that through, it's only a little graze as far as the account goes.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Can someone ring back about an accident at Doncaster please. Please get back to us about it so someone can speak to the driver and pick this up. The driver has asked for a call, and I'm putting that request through here.

Please come back to us about this.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

What a shock, that car nearly killed the driver on the M1 SB near Luton! Nobody hurt, load fine, and the driver continued. He is still shaken by it. Artic NV20 PNK had to brake hard when it cut sharply in front, but there was no contact.

Please come back to us about this.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

One pallet missing on delivery at Wrenfield Dairies' ambient warehouse, from artic NV18 LMD. The seal was still intact and matching when checked. We can't explain the shortage. The artic had stopped overnight in the secure truck park near Markham Moor on the A1.

Please come back to us about this.

Caller: We're two pallets short against the delivery note on the Pennine Paints customer delivery.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: It was a mis-pick; those pallets never went on the vehicle. The delivery note listed them so the delivery came up two short.
Caller: Seal was intact. Can we arrange to get the pallets from the warehouse to the customer please.

NV20 EAG was in a lay-by on the A1 near Grantham overnight. At 06:00 the driver found the offside curtain slashed. All pallets are there but Pennine Paints' emulsion tins are pierced and dented. This emulsion isn't dangerous goods. Nothing has been taken, just the damaged tins and curtain to report.

Caller: Marlow & Finch homeware delivery to the Cardiff store is three pallets short against the delivery note.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Two of the pallets that did arrive are crushed as well.
Caller: The seal was intact, but we haven't got an explanation for the shortage yet. Please pick up both points with this delivery.

Hello, passing on the subcontractor's account below.

Four flooring pallets have holes through the packs from forklift tines, according to Greystone's Derby branch. The Ashby driver says the packs were damaged when loading at their cross-dock. Please follow this up. It was Northvale freight delivered by Ashby Haulage, laminate flooring.

Please come back to us about this.

Depot's report, as received: A shunter reversed a trailer without a banksman and nearly hit somebody walking across the yard. Yesterday afternoon a pedestrian crossing Northvale Warrington depot yard was nearly hit by a reversing trailer. A colleague has raised it today rather than yesterday. Please follow up what happened in the yard.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Just asking for recovery for NV68 PLW, the 18-tonne rigid curtainsider on the A49 near Leominster. Load is building supplies for Greystone Builders Merchants in Hereford, no deadline to flag. Gearbox has failed just beyond a bend, vehicle immovable on the single carriageway. Traffic is passing it by using the opposite lane.

Please come back to us about this.

Caller: Trailer brakes on NV19 FPL caught fire in the HGV park at Hilton Park services, M6.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Driver has moved people away and called the fire brigade.
Caller: It's the artic carrying ambient paper products for Marlow & Finch. Please pick up the fire report from the services.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

The furniture export on artic NV19 RRT won't reach Holyhead check-in until 7.55pm, according to the sat-nav. Paperwork for customs is in order. Job specifically flags the ferry cut-off and a contract breach if we take the next sailing. Roadworks near Conwy on the A55 have held it up. The 20:15 Dublin sailing closes check-in at 19:30.

Please come back to us about this.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

NV19 KTX, the Scania R450 carrying Tollbridge Retail flat-pack furniture at ambient, is stopped in the A38 lay-by near Burton. No collision or injuries; the driver has shut the engine down. Debris hit and split the vehicle's diesel tank, with fuel still running out over the lay-by and onto the road.

Please come back to us about this.

Driver's report, as received: Driver braked hard, no contact and nobody hurt. Load fine and he carried on. What a shock, that car nearly killed the driver on the M1 SB near Luton! Nobody hurt, load fine, and the driver continued. He is still shaken by it.

Driver's report, as received: Job flagged 'ferry cut-off, next sailing breaches contract'. Check-in closes 19:30 but sat-nav now says 19:55. The furniture export on artic NV19 RRT won't reach Holyhead check-in until 7.55pm, according to the sat-nav. Paperwork for customs is in order. Job specifically flags the ferry cut-off and a contract breach if we take the next sailing.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

The CMR for Sable Electronics' speaker export to Rotterdam has no consignor signature. Could somebody get the signature sorted on that document please, passing on the pre-departure check. Driver spotted it at Northvale Thurrock depot, vehicle still there and not yet departed.

Please come back to us about this.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Marlow & Finch's Ashford warehouse delivery of wine on NV21 GDP will be late. CMR and declarations have been checked and are correct. It's held for the examination, expected release in three to four hours. The artic arrived Dover Eastern Docks from Calais and Border Force selected it for x-ray plus a physical examination.

Please come back to us about this.

Driver's report, as received: He's pulled onto the hard shoulder, now safe behind the crash barrier, tyre service called. That was a MASSIVE bang on NV20 YHT, driver says he thought he was going to die. Artic has ambient Marlow & Finch paper products, no deadline. He's badly shaken.

Driver's report, as received: Artic parked in the depot with ambient bottled water for a Tollbridge Retail store, delivery 07:00. Jump pack or another tractor requested for NV23 FPE at Northvale Avonmouth depot. It's parked at the depot, loaded with Tollbridge Retail ambient bottled water for a seven o'clock store delivery.

Driver's report, as received: Can somebody pick this up and get back to the driver please. The driver says a box was damaged on the drop; customer refused a pallet. I'm putting the report through here so it gets picked up and somebody can follow up the refusal.

Driver's report, as received: The ENS safety and security declaration hasn't been lodged for the Tollbridge Retail ambient stock load. Driver is waiting parked up at Holyhead for the broker after Dublin sailing check-in was refused at one this morning. There's another sailing in four hours.

Caller: Scania R450 NV19 KTX has pulled into a lay-by on the A38 near Burton after debris split its own diesel tank.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Debris hit and split the vehicle's diesel tank, with fuel still running out over the lay-by and onto the road.
Caller: Load is ambient flat-pack furniture for Tollbridge Retail.

Depot's report, as received: It's Brackenridge Foods cereal; boxes are crushed and torn. Two Brackenridge Foods cereal pallets have crushed and torn boxes at Northvale Daventry depot. No one was injured. Passing the loading account through for follow-up.

Driver's report, as received: Goods-in supervisor wouldn't sign until her manager checked the load, and the manager wasn't available. Fenwick Garden Supplies' Chelmsford store have the goods, but the driver has no signed POD. Driver left the delivery there. We need someone to follow this up with the store.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Corvid Automotive's assembly parts on artic NV21 LJC won't reach the plant until half three. Our diversion is via A515 because the eastbound A50 near Uttoxeter is closed after a fuel spill, not ours. It is a just-in-time job with a two o'clock line-side contract slot and 'line stop penalty' on the sheet.

Please come back to us about this.

Driver's report, as received: Customs picked it for a documentary check; documents are in order, but release is expected in two hours. Brackenridge RDC will need to rebook the cheese delivery on chilled trailer NV23 BDE, inbound Holyhead from Dublin. Unit is running as normal and the box reads three degrees.

Paperwork's wrong on the Rotterdam job, can somebody ring the driver please. That's the report we've got about it and the request is for a call back. Please pick this up and talk it through rather than leave it sitting here.

Empty curtainsider NVT 3302 is on the perimeter at Northvale Thurrock depot. This morning both red and yellow air lines were found cut and two tyres slashed. There's a gap in the fence nearby. Nothing taken, trailer was empty, but we can't move it until it's repaired.

Caller: NVT 2218 is at Northvale Avonmouth depot after the heavy rain.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Trailer is at Northvale Avonmouth depot following heavy rain, with a tear in the roof sheet where the water got in.
Caller: Please pick up the wet cartons and the torn sheet on this trailer.

Depot's report, as received: At 22:15 the reefer alarmed, shut down and won't restart. Box was 3 °C at 21:30, now 7 °C and climbing. NVT 4471 has Wrenfield Dairies chilled dairy, yoghurt and cream, due out of Northvale Warrington depot at five in the morning. Box up from 3 °C at 21:30 to 7 °C now, still rising, no engineer on site.

Caller: At Fenwick Garden Supplies' Ipswich warehouse the driver noticed a damaged racking upright in goods-in.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: It's damaged and leaning a bit in the goods-in area. Customer already notified.
Caller: Please pick up the report about the racking at this delivery site and follow it through with them.

Caller: NV66 JHN delivered kitchen units to the Marlow & Finch site in Reading.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: That same account includes customer photographs taken at the tailgate of two crushed carcass boxes.
Caller: Nothing missing; this was the curtainsider, seal not relevant here.

Driver's report, as received: RDC yard team think their shunter has moved it to the overflow yard and they're checking. Can't find loaded Northvale trailer NVT 4012 on the booked bay at Brackenridge RDC Doncaster, we've LOST it! Ambient snacks, no deadline, but I'm panicking over where this whole trailer has gone.

Six cages of Marlow & Finch stationery are missing from the Bristol trailer. Northvale Daventry hub have traced the mistake: they cross-docked them onto the Warrington trailer. All six are at Northvale Warrington depot untouched. Can someone arrange to get them onto the correct run please.

Caller: NV68 DYE clipped a bollard reversing at Tollbridge RDC Lutterworth.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Only a minor scrape on the rear vehicle corner, but the bollard has bent.
Caller: Nobody hurt and goods fine. Please record what happened on the reverse and come back to us if you need to speak to the driver.

Caller: NV17 AJD collected mixed pallets at Pennine Paints in Huddersfield.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Loading was done without the driver watching: pallets of bagged tile adhesive were double-stacked onto light-fitting boxes.
Caller: At Greystone Builders Merchants in Oxford the cartons underneath were crushed; goods-in put that on the POD.

NV18 WEF has ambient flooring for Greystone Builders Merchants in Leeds. Driver has reached his working-time duty limit at Lymm services and must take his daily rest. Delivery moves from this evening to 07:00 tomorrow. Please pass on that revised arrival and pick up the rest requirement.

Driver's report, as received: Driver has noticed the CMR isn't signed by the consignor. The CMR for Sable Electronics' speaker export to Rotterdam has no consignor signature. Could somebody get the signature sorted on that document please, passing on the pre-departure check.

Caller: NV21 GDP inbound from Calais at Dover Eastern Docks with Marlow & Finch wine has been selected by Border Force.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: The artic arrived Dover Eastern Docks from Calais and Border Force selected it for x-ray plus a physical examination.
Caller: Vehicle held with release expected in 3–4 hours. Ashford warehouse delivery will be late.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Marlow & Finch's kitchenware on artic NV21 TRN is being held at Dover by Border Force. It's making the warehouse delivery late. There isn't a flagged deadline on the job, but the document needs sorting to get it moving. They've identified an incorrect commodity code on the T1 transit paperwork.

Please come back to us about this.

Redgate Logistics driver on the Northvale parcels trunk reports at 01:30. M25 closed J10 to J11 overnight for a police incident, nothing involving us. The trunk into Northvale Daventry depot will be about three hours late. Ambient parcels, no deadline flagged; please pass the new timing on.

Customer's report, as received: Could somebody get back to us about this please. Please can you advise us about damage to some of the delivery received today. This is to report the damage and ask for someone to get back to us.

Lorry's broken down, warning light on the dash and lost power. Vehicle has stopped and the driver is waiting for recovery. Please can somebody pick this up and get back to the driver about it, passing on the report as received.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Driver has reported a racking upright at the Fenwick Garden Supplies warehouse in Ipswich. No injuries. Sending the observation through so someone can follow up the condition of the racking. It's damaged and leaning a bit in the goods-in area. Customer already notified.

Please come back to us about this.

Driver's report, as received: The report says all customs paperwork is fine, but also that the French broker has rejected the declaration for a wrong EORI number. Driver waiting in the Calais lorry park, artic NV22 YAC heading to Dover with Pennine Paints returns from export. That's the account being passed through.

Caller: The pallet for Fenwick isn't on the van, no idea where it's gone.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: There's no idea where it's gone, that's the report we've been given.
Caller: I'm passing on the report as it stands; we need someone to look into that missing pallet.

NV20 RXC has rear-ended a car in slow traffic on the A34 near Oxford. The car driver is complaining of neck pain; both vehicles are stopped in lane 1. Police on the way. Northvale driver unhurt and the ambient grocery load is intact. Passing this through now.

Driver's report, as received: Tail-lift dropped suddenly while lowering, tipping the pallet and cracking about a third of the tiles. About a third of the ceramic tiles on the pallet for Greystone Builders Merchants in Stoke-on-Trent have cracked. No one was near it, no injuries. Please arrange for the lift to be checked as well.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

The Greystone Builders Merchants Leeds flooring delivery on artic NV18 WEF will now be seven tomorrow morning rather than this evening. The load is ambient flooring. Please update the delivery timing. Driver is at Lymm services, at his duty-time limit, and has to take his daily rest.

Please come back to us about this.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Jump pack or another tractor requested for NV23 FPE at Northvale Avonmouth depot. It's parked at the depot, loaded with Tollbridge Retail ambient bottled water for a seven o'clock store delivery. Driver arrived for the early run at five past three and found flat batteries, tractor won't start.

Please come back to us about this.

Caller: Two-person home delivery in Swindon for Tollbridge Retail, a 65-inch television.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Screen was cracked when unboxed with the crew watching, despite the outside of the carton looking fine.
Caller: Customer refused the television and the crew took it back. Please follow up the damaged set.

NV71 ZPU is the frozen trailer with Carrier reefer on the A1 to Brackenridge RDC Doncaster. Unit showed a fault code at 14:20. Driver stopped at services and restarted it, running normally since. Box -19 °C, set point -20 °C. He wants an engineer to check it at the depot tonight.

Caller: NV20 EAG was in a lay-by on the A1 near Grantham overnight.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: At six this morning the offside curtain was found cut open, with pierced and dented emulsion paint tins on the Pennine Paints pallets.
Caller: This emulsion isn't dangerous goods. Nothing has been taken, just the damaged tins and curtain to report.

Driver's report, as received: They checked licence, tacho and load; everything in order. Vehicle held around two hours. Tollbridge Retail's ambient delivery on NV67 SXA has lost about two hours at a random police stop. All were in order. It's the time held for the check that's making the delivery late.

Driver's report, as received: The goods themselves match their order; it's only the note that's wrong. Please correct the delivery note for Greystone Builders Merchants in Leicester. They are holding payment of the invoice until a corrected note comes through.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Tollbridge Retail Kettering's four pallets of homeware have gone to their Northampton store on rigid NV70 BKT. Northampton confirm the pallets are safe with them and they're ready to give them back. Please sort getting them across. It was a driver error with the drop sheet, wrong store.

Please come back to us about this.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Driver's report is 'had a bump this morning, all ok'. I'm putting it here for someone to pick up and come back to us about the bump. Would somebody call back about it please, that's the account being passed on.

Please come back to us about this.

Driver's report, as received: Driver first says he's on the hard shoulder, then says cars are swerving round the back of the trailer in lane 1. Recovery requested for artic NV22 BMO on M25 ACW near J27, air escaping and brakes locked. Driver out of cab. Load is ambient beverages for Oakhurst Brewery's customers.

Wrenfield Dairies butter export to Cork via Fishguard hasn't left Northvale Avonmouth depot yet. Depot noticed before departure that the vet's stamp on the export health certificate is dated wrongly. Reefer is working normally. Please sort the date on the certificate for this export load.

Caller: NV23 KPX is at Holyhead with Kestrel Pharma prescription medicines for a Dublin hospital, due 08:00 tomorrow.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Holyhead check-in won't accept it without the missing export declaration MRN; the 02:40 boat is the last one that makes that window.
Caller: Last sailing that gets it there in time is 02:40 and the broker isn't answering. Driver and load fine.

Caller: Wrenfield Dairies butter export to Cork via Fishguard hasn't left Northvale Avonmouth depot yet.
Desk: Right, go on.
Caller: Depot spotted it before departure at Northvale Avonmouth. Load is for a Cork customer via Fishguard and is still at the depot.
Caller: Reefer is working normally. Please sort the date on the certificate for this export load.

Hello, passing on the driver's account below.

Customer in Bradford has refused damaged Pennine Paints drums: three dented, with a lid cracked on one. All upright and nothing seen leaking or smelt. Sending the drum details through. The 25-litre steel drums contain UN1263 paint, ADR class 3 flammable. Damage found when opening the trailer.

Please come back to us about this.
